source: team scale press test (rough): single FSR, round contact d = 3.15 cm, Arduino Uno A0

conditions.note: pressure = applied force / contact area (estimated). Uno readings are exact 10-bit codes 250, 300, ..., 470 (V = code * 5 / 1023).

transfer_to_stm32.board: NUCLEO-H723ZG, ADC1 12-bit (0..4095), offset+linearity calibration, no VREFBUF, VREFINT not read
transfer_to_stm32.rule: ratiometric: the FSR divider and VREF+ are fed from the same 3V3 rail, so counts = 4095 * Vout / VREF+ = 4095 * divider ratio, independent of the exact rail voltage; ratio = uno_V / 5.0
transfer_to_stm32.requires: the same divider (resistor value and topology) as on the STM32 bank; otherwise remap through the FSR resistance (fsr_curve.py --rm_uno / --rm_stm)
transfer_to_stm32.volts_display: V = counts * VREF+ / 4095 with VREF+ = 3.3 V nominal (not measured)

fit.model: counts = cmax F^n / (F^n + F50^n), F on the calibration contact
